**Heartbeat: Stale Plans (>7d inactive)**

4 of 51 active-ish plans show no task/event activity since >7 days. All are archived or located under `semiotic-repository/planning/ideas/`:

| Days | Status | Plan |
|------|--------|------|
| 28d | active | `plans/0053-model-capability-requirements-in-skills.md` (archive) |
| 28d | active | `plans/0054-local-model-autonomous-agents.md` (archive) |
| 27d | active | `plans/0059-standards-deviation-measurement.md` |
| 27d | active | `plans/0060-agents-routing-chain-to-file-location-skill.md` |

**Caveats:**
- Plan and task entities only carry `date-created` (no `last-modified`). Activity proxied via task creation + events.jsonl subjects.
- All 4 lack `id:` frontmatter — they don't link to tasks by `part-of`, so "no task activity" here means "nothing in the graph references them."
- The 47 other active plans all have activity within 7d (recent sprint created under `flatfile-system` / sunday-funday-sprint on 2026-04-05).

**Suggested actions:** archive the two already-in-`archive/` plans to `status: completed` or `superseded`; the two `ideas/` plans likely want explicit `status: deferred` or `id:` frontmatter so they participate in dispatch.
